Class VcsDiff

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.resource.vcs.VcsDiff
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class VcsDiff extends Object implements Serializable
Strongly-typed DTO representing the unified diff comparison of a file against a repository revision or working copy.

anahata
